units.source_text: 总之，我体验到一种不期而合的东西在起作用。

en.t: In short, I experienced something unexpectedly corresponding at work.

units.source_text: 犹如镜中的走廊，一个影像会一直延续到无限的深处，过去所见的事物的影子也会清晰地反射在新遇见的事物上。

en.t: Like a corridor in a mirror, one image would continue on into infinite depths, and the shadows of things seen in the past would also be reflected clearly upon things newly encountered.

units.source_text: 我被这种相似所引导，不觉间走到了走廊的深处，心情像是步进了摸不着边际的内室一样。

en.t: Guided by this resemblance, I found myself walking into the depths of the corridor, feeling as though I had stepped into an inner chamber with no discernible limit.

units.source_text: 我们并非突然遇到命运这玩意儿。

en.t: We do not suddenly encounter this thing called fate.

units.source_text: 日后应判处死刑的汉子，

en.t: A man who is later to be sentenced to death,

units.source_text: 平时走在街上所遇见的电线杆或火车道口，

en.t: in the utility poles or railway crossings he ordinarily encounters while walking through town,

units.source_text: 也会不断地描绘出刑架的幻影，

en.t: will also continually trace out the phantom image of the scaffold,

units.source_text: 同时应该对这种幻影感到亲切。

en.t: and at the same time should feel a certain intimacy with that phantom.
